sections.appearance: She has a long blonde hair reaching her legs with braids tied to her left side, gray jagged horns and bright violet blue eyes with pink cross pupils. Halo ==== Akari's halo has a magenta diamond inside a cyan circle surrounded by six spikes in different sizes. Three spikes are spread out outside of the circle on one side, and three spikes are held closely together on the edge of the circle on the other. Uniform ==== She wears a long black military uniform with tassels, red and white linings, gray collar tied with a red ribbon, gold buttons and white Gehenna logo on her left sleeve strapped with two belts connected to gold chains. She also wears a pant skirt underneath, black stockings and black high-heeled shoes. Gym: She wore a red school gym shirt over her outfit, with white sleeves and two red stripes running down the cuffs. She was wearing red school gym pants with two stripes on the sides, and no gloves. She was wearing white socks with red stripes near the edges. She also had a pair of white athletic shoes with black soles and a red section in the middle. Firearm ==== thumb|Bottomless|150px She uses a black HK416F assault rifle with a bit of red dotting around the entire rifle. It is fitted with an underbarrel HK M320 Grenade Launcher attachment (which she uses during her EX skill) and an EOTECH HHS I Hybrid Sight. A white Gehenna insignia is imprinted on the stock. The school's name is stamped on the launcher sights.

sections.personality: Despite Akari's quiet and calm apperance, like the rest of Gourmet Research Society, she occasionally causes trouble for others. She also has the capability of consuming absurd amounts food without gaining weight at all, making all-you-can-eat buffets seem like child's play, allowing her to become the champion of the Kivotos Eating Tournament by as eating over 50 bowls of ramen without getting a stomach ache.
